summary: SMJ International Holdings, a Singapore-based Form 6-K foreign private issuer, disclosed the September 29, 2026 resignation of executive director Ms. Lee Lay Choo and CFO Ms. Low Yeen Mei Sherina, effective immediately, with neither citing disagreement with the company. On September 30, 2026, the board appointed Ms. AiLian Li, age 62, as executive director and CFO effective October 1, 2026, at a US$2,000 monthly base salary under an employment agreement with three-month notice and indemnification. Watch for governance continuity and any restatement or audit-timing risk tied to the abrupt CFO turnover.
